title: Mercy Kwambai back-to-back champion — official 2025 results and edition post
claims: The 2025 event was the 25th edition, with an estimated 1,400 participants.
Full marathon men's winner: Samson Lemayan; women's winner: Mercy Kwambai, defended her title in 2 hours 47 minutes.
Half marathon men's winner: Michael Kamau; women's winner: Mary Waithera.
Executive 10 km men's winner: Reuben Ng'ang'a; women's winner: Sara Van Der Laan; Junior 5 km winners: Collins Muthee and Sylvia Akoron.
The men's full-marathon winning time and a full finisher list are not published in this article.
